title: The Benefits of Explainer Videos for Small Businesses (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: The Benefits of Explainer Videos
slides.notes: Your small business answers the same questions every day. What if you explained it well once, and a video kept doing the job for you?

slides.title: Explain once, reuse many times
slides.notes: Every small business fields the same questions daily. A short video answers each one the same way, without anyone on your team stopping what they're doing.

slides.title: Clearer, consistent and always on
bullets: Shows the steps while explaining them
Works at night and on weekends
Every customer hears the same message
slides.notes: Video shows the steps while it explains them. It works when you're offline, keeps every detail accurate and on brand, and captions help more people understand.

slides.title: Start where explanation changes behaviour
slides.notes: Pick the spot where a clear explanation would change what people do. That might be your homepage, a welcome email or the follow-up after a first call.

slides.title: Five slides make a one-minute script
bullets: Situation, problem, answer, proof, next step
Problem: "Your BAS takes a whole weekend"
slides.notes: Use situation, problem, answer, proof, next step. For a local bookkeeper, that's five slides, a sentence or two of narration each, and about a minute of video.

slides.title: Turn your sales deck into an explainer
bullets: Write narration in the speaker notes
slides.notes: Start with the deck you already have. On Pro, a.i. directs the video, so it looks produced without an agency. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
